title: Ghostwriter seo-verifier reply (structured output)
description: One verdict for every link and suggestion shown: keep it, keep it with better words from the same sentence, or drop it. The id enum is filled for each call.

notes.description: First, a few words for yourself on what you checked. Never shown to the editor.

id.description: The link (l1, l2…) or the suggestion (m1, m2…).

verdict.description: keep: the page and the words are right. keep-with-anchor: the page is right, better words are in `anchor`. drop: the page is wrong or misleading there.

anchor.description: Only with keep-with-anchor: 2 to 8 words copied exactly from the same sentence, to become the link's words instead. Otherwise empty.
